name: Quip
description: Documents, spreadsheets, messages, folders, users, sharing, exports, blobs, and collaboration through Quip's Automation API.
agentUseSummary: A Quip company admin enters a customer-owned API key once, then users connect through OAuth and agents use selected Automation API capabilities under Safe or Dangerously skip permissions.

credentialRequirements.name: QUIP_CLIENT_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Quip API key client ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: A Quip company admin creates an API key with USER_READ, USER_WRITE, and USER_MANAGE.

credentialRequirements.name: QUIP_CLIENT_SECRET
credentialRequirements.label: Quip API key client secret
credentialRequirements.helpText: Railway encrypts the customer-owned secret and uses it only for Quip OAuth, refresh, and revocation.

capabilities.label: Read Quip
capabilities.description: Read the connected user's authorized Quip knowledge and collaboration resources.

capabilities.label: Manage Quip content
capabilities.description: Create, edit, copy, message, upload, export, archive, and delete authorized Quip resources.

capabilities.label: Manage Quip sharing
capabilities.description: Manage authorized membership, access, link sharing, locks, and folders.

allowed.label: Read Quip
allowed.description: Read user-authorized Quip documents, spreadsheets, messages, folders, users, and metadata.

approvalRequired.label: Change Quip
approvalRequired.description: Create, edit, copy, export, message, upload, archive, or delete authorized Quip resources.

approvalRequired.label: Manage Quip sharing
approvalRequired.description: Manage provider-authorized thread and folder access, link sharing, locks, and membership.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Typed reads run directly; every upload, write, delete, export, message, or sharing/management request requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Every selected, API-key-scoped Quip action runs without Relay per-action approval; ownership, fixed origin, selected capabilities, bounds, audits, secret non-exposure, Quip permissions, and provider limits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts bounded Quip Automation API wrappers and attaches refreshed customer OAuth tokens server-side.
Railway mounts bounded Quip Automation API wrappers and attaches refreshed customer OAuth tokens server-side.

providerSetup.blocker: A Quip company admin must create a customer-owned API key with all three Automation scopes; Relay cannot create one global cross-company Quip key.
providerSetup.nextAction: In the customer's Quip Admin Console create a dedicated API key with USER_READ, USER_WRITE, and USER_MANAGE, enter the client ID and secret in Relay Console, approve OAuth, and run health/read/Safe denial/approval/Dangerous/revoke checks.

evidence.supports: Quip documents the complete current read/write Automation API, customer-admin-created API keys, USER_READ/USER_WRITE/USER_MANAGE scopes, 30-day OAuth tokens with refresh, revoke and verify endpoints, company/user permissions, and default per-user rate limits.
Quip publishes downloadable current and historical OpenAPI specifications for its Automation API, supporting a version-preserving fixed-origin wrapper rather than a stale endpoint subset.
